interview.name: Opal
interview.answer: The repair drive’s location and time are still unconfirmed.

reflections: Opal is being proactive and reliable, keeping track of the repair drive logistics for others.
Mina and Nell both depend on Opal for location updates and coordination, suggesting Opal is a useful point of contact.
The interaction is calm and collaborative, with Nell planning to visit later and Opal staying attentive at the check-in table.
Opal is the reliable coordinator who keeps track of logistics and asks for missing details without assuming them.
Nell and Gus respond cooperatively and seem comfortable checking in later or contributing practical help.
Bo is willing to help but still needs confirmed location details before acting, so the group depends on a shared update path.
Opal is acting as the coordination point, repeatedly tracking uncertain event details and relaying them back to others.
The group is collaborative and responsive, with people offering supplies, tools, and follow-up checks even when the location is still unconfirmed.
The repair drive still lacks a confirmed location, but the team already has a clear sense of likely needs: screws, duct tape, and flashlights.
Opal is the organizer who keeps tracking logistics and shares updates calmly across the group.
Bo and Tess are cooperative but currently missing key details, so they defer to follow-up rather than guessing.
Uli has finally provided the concrete repair-drive location and time, which likely resolves the outstanding scheduling question.
Opal is acting as the organizer and tracker, repeatedly asking for confirmation and keeping everyone updated.
The group communication is focused on a shared repair-drive location and timing, with uncertainty resolving through direct confirmations.
Uli and Pia appear to have the clearest location details, while Hana is still waiting for confirmation before acting.

events.text: Opal: I don’t have any repair-drive details yet, but I can help keep track of the location if you tell me where it’s happening.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Mina: Do you know where the repair drive is being held?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Opal: Not yet—I don’t have the location confirmed. If you tell me where it’s being held, I’ll keep track of it.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Opal: I’m headed to the repair drive now, Nell—if you need me, I’ll be near the check-in table.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal—I'll probably stop by a little later and check the table. Let me know if you hear anything I should know.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Opal: Will do, Nell—I'll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes at the check-in table.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair-drive location confirmed yet, Gus. If you know where it’s being held, I can keep track of it for us.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Gus: It’s at the community shed on Saturday at 3 PM. I can bring a few tools too, and we shouldn’t be there too long.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Opal: Great, I’ve got it: the community shed on Saturday at 3 PM. I’ll keep track of that location, and your tools offer is really helpful.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Bo: I can still bring screws and duct tape, and I’ll check for a flashlight too. Just tell me where to drop it off.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Opal: I still don’t have the drop-off location confirmed. If you tell me where the repair drive is being held, I’ll keep track of it for you.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Bo: I’m not sure either — I only know I can bring the supplies. Let me check and I’ll get back to you.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair-drive location confirmed yet, Tess. If you know where it’s being held, I can keep track of it for us.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Tess: I don’t have the location confirmed yet either, but I’ll keep my ears open and pass it along as soon as I hear. Folks are still saying screws, duct tape, and a couple flashlights are the big needs right now.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep tracking it too, and I’ll note the supplies in the meantime.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair-drive location confirmed yet, Bo. If you know where it’s being held, I can keep track of it for us.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Bo: I don’t have the location yet either—still waiting on that detail. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep tracking it too, and let me know as soon as you hear the location.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair-drive location confirmed yet, Uli. If you know where it’s being held, I can keep track of it for us.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Uli: It’s by my garage on Saturday at 10. I’ll let you know if anything changes.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — I’ve got it noted: by your garage on Saturday at 10. If it changes, just let me know and I’ll keep track.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair-drive location confirmed yet, Hana. If you know where it’s being held, I can keep track of it for us.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Hana: I don’t know the location yet either—once it’s confirmed, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Hana — I’ll keep it on my list and wait for the confirmed location.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Pia: Saturday at 10 by Leo’s garage still works for me. If the location changes, please let me know right away so I can plan accordingly.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll keep Leo’s garage at Saturday 10 on my list and let you know if I hear any change.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — that works for me. I’m keeping Saturday at 10 by Leo’s garage on my calendar.
events.speaker: Pia
